授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This course systematically studies causal inference and empirical research design through an English-language reading seminar. The fourth class is an R tutorial, and from the fifth class onward students present assigned chapters.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: Nick Huntington-Klein, The Effect: An Introduction to Research Design and Causality を通じて、因果効果の定義、研究デザイン、識別仮定、代表的な実証手法の位置づけを理解し、労働経済学を含む実証研究を批判的に読解・設計できる力を養う。授業前半では教員講義により第1章から第5章までを概説し、後半ではRチュートリアルと受講者発表を通じて第20章までを読み進める。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course develops the ability to understand causal inference, research design, and identification through Nick Huntington-Klein, The Effect: An Introduction to Research Design and Causality. The first three classes cover Chapters 1 to 5 through instructor lectures, the fourth class provides an R tutorial, and from the fifth class onward students present the remaining chapters through Chapter 20.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: causal inference, research design, identification, R, econometrics, reading seminar
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Students are expected to have undergraduate-level knowledge of econometrics and statistics. Familiarity with basic R operations before the course begins is desirable.
